reply.emotion: warm and bright, smiling while speaking with genuine contentment
notes: Feliz does not change for masculine or feminine; it only adds -es in the plural (felices).
It covers both being happy in oneself and having good fortune in life.

senses.definition: Que siente o manifiesta felicidad, agrado o bienestar.

examples.text: Ella está muy feliz con su nuevo trabajo.
examples.translation: She is very happy with her new job.
examples.emotion: enthusiastic and upbeat, sharing good news with a friend

senses.definition: Que se halla en un estado de dicha o buena fortuna.

examples.text: Tuvieron un viaje feliz sin ningún contratiempo.
examples.translation: They had a fortunate trip without any setbacks.
examples.emotion: relieved and satisfied looking back on a smooth experience

definitions: Que siente o manifiesta felicidad, agrado o bienestar.
Que se halla en un estado de dicha o buena fortuna.
